name: Multiple IDO Projects
rootCause: 7 IDO projects on BSC are suspected to be running, namely $GOTEM (gotEM), $ONEP (HarmonyPad), $HBARP (HbarPad), $MPLAY (MetaPlay), $ELIT (Electrinity) and $PEE (MicroPee) $QDrop (QuizDrop), swept away more than 5,744 WBNB, and the funds were transferred out through Tornado.Cash.
